response_text: You can’t call osYield() inside context-switching functions like PendSV_Handler, SVC_Handler_Main, or SysTick_Handler because those functions are already part of the context switch process. They’re running in exception mode, not thread mode, and osYield() is meant to be called from thread mode to trigger a context switch, not perform one. If you try to call it from inside one of these handlers, you’ll just end up triggering another context switch while already handling one, which can cause recursive exceptions or corrupt the stack. It basically breaks the whole flow of the OS and can make the system crash or behave unpredictably.\n
